'''Angla''' is a [[novice]] and part of the [[Rebel Aes Sedai]] in [[Salidar]].

==History==
Angla was born in {{ne|973}} and enrolled in the White Tower as a novice in {{ne|990}}.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Angla}}

She has been a novice for ten years.

== Activities ==
She is one of eighteen novices taken from the [[White Tower]] during the coup by [[Sheriam Bayanar]]. The other include [[Tabiya]] and [[Lucilde]].{{ref/book|6|8}}

She is part of the [[Link]] controlled by [[Anaiya]] when the [[Bubble of evil]] erupts in [[Salidar]]. After the incident, [[Anaiya Carel]] orders Angla to lend a little strength in [[Healing]] the resulting casualties. She is taken away by [[Bharatine]].{{ref/book|6|14}}
